text:
Arun P (People Ops): Quick drop 1 1 — tiny 'review signal cards' for managers and ICs. Want something ultra-short to paste into review forms or slack. Please thumbs up or two quick edits.

Arun P: Goal: 3-line card + optional tags. Lines: 1) Goal (measurable), 2) Outcome/Evidence (link or tag), 3) Ask (what help you need). Tags: [Evidence:A/B/C], [Risk:Low/Med/High], [Beneficiary:<team>].

Zoe (Eng): Love the simplicity. Suggest adding a one-word 'scope' prefix (e.g., infra, model, client) so reviewers know context at glance.

Arun P: Good call 1 adding Scope. Example card below.

Arun P: Example (copy-paste):
"Scope: infra
Goal: Cut P95 inference latency 12% for chat-api (us-west)
Outcome: P95 -12% (dash-312) | PR#2870 [Evidence:A] [Risk:Low] [Beneficiary:Search] | Ask: Need help scheduling night canary"

Marcel (Manager): Tiny nit: can we make Outcome accept a short qualitative form when metric missing? e.g., "customer story: quote-id"

Arun P: Yes — allow qualitative with tag [Evidence:C]. Update example:
"Scope: model
Goal: Improve answer relevance for small-context prompts by demo score +8pts
Outcome: demo-sample +8pts (eval-421) [Evidence:B] | Ask: time to run expanded evals"

Toni (People Ops): Recommend a one-line manager micro-script to read at 1:1s: "Pick one example that moved a metric and one thing you want me to help remove as a blocker." Keeps it human.

Marcel (Manager): Also add a calibration checkbox managers can paste into calibration threads: "Dashboard linked? Runbook present? Post-rollout incidents?" Helps reduce followups.

Arun P: Adding calibration checkbox and a footer in the handbook linking to growth/hiring ops: "If promoting or role change expected, submit a Hiring Ops request within 10 days — template link."

hr-bot: Draft published: https://handbook.redwood.company/people-ops/review-signal-cards (internal)

Zoe (Eng): I'll try these with my team this cycle. If uptake is low maybe add a tiny checkbox in the form that pre-fills one of these cards to lower friction.

Arun P: Plan: fold in scope prefix, qualitative evidence guidance, manager micro-script, calibration checkbox and push final tomorrow AM. Thanks for the quick reviews! :white_check_mark:
